segments.text: How are you feeling about your workload this month?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: It's heavy, the reporting work takes most of my week.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Feedback for you: your incident write-up last week was really clear.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Thanks. For my growth I'd like to lead a small project next quarter.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Good, I'll look for a project you can lead by the end of the month.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I'll automate the weekly report so it takes less time.
